title: A covering construction of labelled packing measure and content
summary: We introduce labelled packing measure by a covering construction in which each set has an independent positive label bounding its diameter and the radii in its local packing cost. Letting the labels tend to zero defines a metric outer measure $M^s$. For every $s>0$ and every metric space $(X,d)$, we prove \[ 2^{-s}{P}^s(F)\le{M}^s(F) \le C(s) P^s(F)\qquad(F\subset X), \] where $ P^s(F)$ is the classical packing measure and $C(s)$ depends only on $s$.
